tagline: Build an economy. Command a nation.

features.title: Land, air & sea
features.text: Command infantry, armour, artillery, helicopters, aircraft, drones, warships and submarines on a 3D campaign map.

features.title: An arsenal that evolves
features.text: Research five equipment tiers, unlock new weapons as the campaign advances and develop your nation's doctrine.

features.title: Win through your economy
features.text: Build industry, manage food, fuel, materials, electronics and manpower, and pursue a dedicated economic victory.

features.title: Real trade routes
features.text: Connect trading partners with trains, container ships and oil tankers. Cargo deliveries grow your national income.

features.title: Diplomacy has consequences
features.text: Negotiate peace, trade agreements, right of way and shared vision. Form coalitions, declare war or impose an embargo.

features.title: Guard your nation
features.text: Use Guard mode for automated defence while you are away. Online matches also give absent nations an AI caretaker.

features.title: Build your nation's future
features.text: Develop cities and provinces with factories, airbases, naval bases, hospitals, support depots, bunkers and railway stations.

features.title: Persistent online play
features.text: Join the 2-player Russia–Ukraine tutorial with your commander account. The server runs the match, remembers your nation and enforces fog of war.

features.title: A deeper battlefield
features.text: Use ranged artillery, air patrols, layered air defence, radar, stealth, entrenchment, retreat and strategic missile weapons.

features.title: Choose your route to victory
features.text: Compete through domination, economic strength, elimination or victory points. Your strategy can reach beyond conquest.

features.title: Know what happens
features.text: Read the war newspaper, battle and Guard reports, track army details and respond to attack alerts.

features.title: Grow as a commander
features.text: Follow achievements, medals, ranks and account progression. Six interface languages and a first-play tutorial help you get started.

updates.title: The browser front is open
updates.text: Play the current Russia–Ukraine campaign in your browser, or sign in to join the online match.

updates.title: One command centre
updates.text: A consistent home across the website, app and game, with campaign access, feature details and music controls in the lobby.

roadmap: Larger Europe and world scenarios are in development. The current playable campaign is Russia–Ukraine.
